Sprout Social is an enterprise social media management platform. Starting at $79 per seat a month on the annual Essentials plan ($199 for Standard with the unified inbox and keyword monitoring), it gives marketing teams scheduling, analytics, listening and a unified inbox. But Sprout Social does not design graphics or produce videos for you. No graphics. No videos. Only AI caption suggestions. You bring the graphics and videos; it suggests captions and pushes the button. And it is built for enterprise brands, not real estate agents.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Does Sprout Social create content for you?

Only caption suggestions. Sprout Social is a scheduling and analytics platform. It does not design graphics or produce videos; it offers basic video trimming and AI caption suggestions. You create graphics and videos yourself or hire a separate team.
Is Sprout Social built for real estate agents?

No. Sprout Social is an enterprise social media management tool built for marketing teams, agencies, and large brands across all industries. It has no real estate-specific features, templates, or content.
Does Sprout Social include video editing?

Only basic edits. Sprout Social has a built-in video editor for cropping, trimming and templates, but it does not produce video for you. For anything beyond a trim or crop, you need to edit videos yourself or hire a separate video editor.
What is Sprout Social’s Trustpilot rating?
Sprout Social has a 1.8 out of 5 rating on Trustpilot, rated “Poor.” Common complaints include high pricing, contract disputes, cancellation difficulties, and slow customer support.
Do I still need other tools if I use Sprout Social?

Yes. Sprout Social handles scheduling, analytics and AI caption suggestions, but you still need a graphic designer or Canva, a video editor for anything beyond trimming, and potentially a social media strategist. That is 2-3 additional tools or hires on top of Sprout Social’s per-seat pricing.
